content_sections.heading: TN NHM Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be conducted by the respective District Health Society or Greater Chennai Corporation according to the approved scoring criteria under G.O.(Ms) No.258 dated 11 September 2026. The selection process includes: Submission of the prescribed offline application. Scrutiny of educational qualifications and supporting documents. Calculation of weighted academic marks. Assessment of district residence eligibility and related marks. Assessment of eligible special-category weightage. Preparation of the selection list based on the approved scoring criteria. Original certificate verification. Issue of appointment orders by the respective authority. Joining and submission of the prescribed declaration and medical fitness certificate. Important: The notification specifies a 100-mark scoring process. It does not prescribe a separate written recruitment examination or interview as part of the notified selection criteria.

content_sections.heading: TN NHM Staff Nurse Selection Marks 2026
content_sections.text: Annexure III-B of the Government Order prescribes a maximum of 100 marks for evaluating applications. SSLC and HSC marks receive a maximum of 20 marks each, calculated according to the candidate's percentage of marks. Formula: Marks Obtained / Total Marks × 20. Applicants must follow the exact academic scoring criteria and applicable rounding or calculation provisions in the official Government Order. Candidates applying in their district of residence can receive up to 25 marks under the notified residence criterion. Valid residence proof must be submitted according to the application form and verification instructions. A maximum of five marks is provided for eligible candidates under the special-category criterion covering Transgender, Ex-Serviceman and Destitute Widow categories. Candidates must possess valid supporting certificates issued by the competent authority. According to the scoring criteria, preference will be given to the older candidate based on date of birth when candidates secure equal marks.

content_sections.heading: TN NHM Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 COVID-19 Pass Marks Clarification
content_sections.text: NHM Tamil Nadu has also issued a clarification dated 24 September 2026 regarding candidates whose SSLC or HSC marksheets show only "PASS" during the COVID-19 examination period. When an SSLC marksheet contains only "PASS", the weightage may be calculated using the candidate's HSC marks according to the prescribed formula. Similarly, when an HSC marksheet contains only "PASS", the candidate's SSLC marks may be used for the corresponding weightage calculation. For example, where a candidate scored 480 out of 600 in HSC and the SSLC marksheet shows only "PASS", the same 80% may be used to determine the SSLC weightage of 16 marks and HSC weightage of 16 marks. Important: This clarification applies only where original marksheets issued by the competent examining authority record "PASS" without numerical marks. If numerical marks are available through the Board's official assessment records, those marks must be used according to the instructions.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TN NHM Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official NHM Tamil Nadu website at nhm.tn.gov.in . Find the Staff Nurse Contractual Recruitment 2026 notification. Check the district-wise vacancies and eligibility requirements. Download the prescribed Staff Nurse application form or obtain it from the respective district website. Print the application form and fill in all required details. Enter personal details, date of birth and contact information. Provide GNM or B.Sc. Nursing qualification information. Enter Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council registration details. Provide SSLC, HSC and nursing qualification marks. Enter current and permanent residential addresses. Specify community and applicable special-category information. Attach self-attested photocopies of the required certificates. Affix the prescribed passport-size photograph. Sign the application declaration. Submit the completed form with documents to the respective District Health Society or notified Greater Chennai Corporation office. Ensure the application reaches the receiving office by 4 December 2026 at 5:00 PM . Keep a copy of the application and submission acknowledgement for future reference. Important: Applications must be submitted through the respective district recruitment process. Candidates should not assume that submitting documents through the general NHM website completes the application.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for TN NHM Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: According to the prescribed application form and Terms of Reference, candidates should submit the following documents as applicable: Birth Certificate, SSLC or HSC certificate as proof of date of birth. SSLC marksheet. HSC marksheet. GNM or B.Sc. Nursing qualification certificate and marksheets. Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council registration certificate. Proof of Tamil-language knowledge. Residence proof, such as Voter ID, Aadhaar Card or Ration Card. Recent passport-size photograph. Community certificate, where applicable. Transgender certificate, where applicable. Ex-Serviceman certificate, where applicable. Destitute Widow certificate, where applicable. Certificate of character and conduct issued by the prescribed authority. Other supporting certificates required for the claimed selection criteria. Self-attested photocopies must accompany the application. Original certificates, one set of self-attested copies and two recent passport-size colour photographs must be produced when called for verification.

content_sections.heading: TN NHM Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 Contract Period
content_sections.text: The Staff Nurse engagement is purely temporary and contractual under National Health Mission Tamil Nadu. The minimum service period prescribed for the position is two years , subject to the contractual terms. The contract will be renewed after completion of every 11 months based on performance appraisal and other applicable conditions. Important: The appointment does not confer any right to permanent absorption, regularization or permanent Government employment.

content_sections.heading: TN NHM Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 Posting and Joining
content_sections.text: The official recruitment instructions state that the place of posting will preferably be close to the candidate's place of residence. However, the final posting will depend on vacancies, institutional requirements and the decision of the District Health Society or Greater Chennai Corporation. Selected candidates must report to the District Health Officer within three days of receiving the appointment order. At the time of joining, candidates must submit a Physical Fitness Certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Civil Surgeon.
